findings.title: Preserve the account UI interpolation syntax
findings.body: This account UI bundle uses i18next-style `{{...}}` interpolation, as in other entries such as `Back to {{app}}`. Changing this message to Java `MessageFormat` placeholders and a ChoiceFormat expression means the UI will display literal `{0}`, `{1}`, and `{2,choice,...}` instead of the attribute name and bounds when this validation error is shown.

findings.title: Preserve the admin UI interpolation syntax
findings.body: This admin UI bundle used i18next-style `{{0}}`, `{{1}}`, and `{{2}}` placeholders. The new Java `MessageFormat` placeholders and ChoiceFormat expression are not interpolated by that UI, so users will see the literal `{0}`, `{1}`, and `{2,choice,...}` in this validation error rather than the attribute name and limits.

findings.title: Use Lithuanian text for the authenticator instruction
findings.body: The `totpStep1` value is Italian (`Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`) in the Lithuanian account theme. Lithuanian users therefore receive an instruction in the wrong language during authenticator setup.

findings.title: Use Lithuanian text for the login authenticator instruction
findings.body: The `loginTotpStep1` value is Italian (`Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`) in the Lithuanian login theme. Lithuanian users therefore receive an instruction in the wrong language during authenticator setup.

findings.title: Use Simplified Chinese in the zh_CN resource
findings.body: This `totpStep1` translation uses Traditional Chinese characters and wording (`手機`, `應用程式`) in the Simplified Chinese `zh_CN` bundle. This makes the authenticator setup instruction inconsistent with the rest of the locale.
